title: Unreal Desserts Banana Toffee 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Banana Toffee from Unreal Desserts brings together the creamy taste of ripe bananas with the rich sweetness of toffee. This e-liquid captures the essence of that beloved classic dessert, providing a comforting and familiar vape experience. The smooth blend of banana and toffee flavours makes for a satisfying all-day vape that's perfect for fans of timeless dessert flavours. Unreal Dessert Nic Salts are expertly crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, making them ideal for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. These e-liquids provide a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine delivery, making them an excellent choice for adult smokers and vapers seeking effective nicotine satisfaction. They are best used with high-resistance coils (0.6ohm-1.2ohm) for both RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) and MTL vaping experiences. Nicotine salts differ from regular freebase e-liquids thanks to their alkaline formulation, allowing for a higher nicotine concentration. Nic Salt e-liquids are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, offering almost instantaneous relief from nicotine cravings. The other benefit of Nic Salts is that you’ll enjoy a super-smooth, comfortable throat hit despite the higher nicotine concentration. Unreal Desserts are a range of Nic Salt E-liquids that are made in the UK by Unreal e-liquids, a brand renowned for their diverse and creative flavours. With Unreal Desserts, the brand has conjured up the most comforting, classic dessert flavours across intensely satisfying Nic Salts and long-lasting 100ml Shortfill E-liquid bottles.
